text:
nina: Heads-up: sampleapp E2E failing on batch embeddings. Python quickstart uses `client.embeddings.create(texts=[...])` and CI is getting 400s from the API: 

ryan: We changed the REST param name to `inputs` (array) to be consistent cross endpoints. Python SDK added `texts` as a convenience in v0.9 but server validation is strict so it rejects `texts`.

sam: Repro: minimal payload that fails:
```py
# Python SDK (current quickstart)
await client.embeddings.create(model='open-embed-1', texts=['a','b'])

# REST accepted body (what server wants)
{"model":"open-embed-1","inputs":["a","b"]}
```

nina: Two UX issues here: (1) param drift (`texts` vs `inputs`) causing onboarding errors; (2) SDK auto-chunking behavior + retries cause duplicate billing when requests are retried by app.

jen-support: Impact: new signups see failures and some customers reported unexpected extra charges when they triggered retries. KB ticket opened.

ryan: Also noticed an async workflow gap: REST responds 202 + Retry-After for long-running embeddings when queueing to dedicated GPUs. The Python SDK currently treats 202 as "done" and returns an empty result instead of polling — so sampleapp never receives embeddings. That's a behavioral mismatch.

sam: CI evidence: ci-bot shows 3 failing integration runs in the last 6 hours with logs: 
```
ci-bot: integration/test_embeddings.py::test_batch_embed FAILED
AssertionError: expected 2 embeddings, got 0
HTTP 400: unexpected property "texts"
HTTP 202: accepted but SDK returned []
```

nina: Proposed fixes: 
- Short term: server accepts `texts` as alias for `inputs` for two releases and emits a deprecation log line.
- Fix SDK: map `texts` -> `inputs` server-side in serialization and add explicit behavior for 202 polling (poll until result or timeout using Retry-After).
- Address retries/billing: make SDK idempotent by default for chunked uploads (attach client-generated idempotency key per logical batch) and document billing implications.

ryan: I'll open PRs: server shim + deprecation log (eng-runtime), and SDK PR to normalize param names + add polling and idempotency keys (sam + nina).

jen-support: I'll post a short note to CS and flag customers who contacted us.

nina: Can we also add an integration test that exercises the 202->poll flow and the chunked retry scenario? Otherwise this will recur.

sam: Yep, I'll add tests to the sample-template CI and a flaky guard for the 202 case.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created issue #452 in redwood/infrastructure: "accept-texts-alias-and-sdk-parity-fixes"

nina: Thanks. Will follow up with PR links in channel when ready.
